narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Six hundred five has digital root five, because it ends in five.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Add its digits: six plus zero plus five is eleven, and one plus one is two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The root comes from all the digits, not the last one.
